Loadouts are premade, map is Candy Cane Lane, and is 12 waves|In-game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Classic Candy Cane Lane''' was the first [[Maps|map]] of [[The Classic Event]]. It has been made available again through the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Triumphing this map rewarded the player with {{Token|1}}. There was also {{Tix|1}} on the map, which could be found at the end of the chocolate river. This map has a premade loadout. It consists of the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Demoman]], [[Soldier]] and [[Paintballer]]. Skins and golden perks could not originally be applied to these towers, though this is not the case in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. This map had four modifiers. The first was [[Enemies Beta]], which changed the appearance of some enemies. The second was [[Classic Roblox]], which activated the next two modifiers on the map. The third modifier was [[Classic Oof]], which made enemies play the old Roblox death sound. The fourth was [[Retro Death]], which made enemies collapse into multiple pieces upon death. When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only [[Classic Oof]] and [[Retro Death]] are applied. ==Design & Path== '''Classic Candy Cane Lane''' is a candy wonderland which is quite evident as the ground is light red and the hills were pink. A massive light red baseplate surrounds the map. Hills surrounds the path, but the terrain was rather flat. The trees around the map mostly have white bark and pink leaves. There is also a chocolate river running through the middle of the map, with a simple wooden bridge spanning it. The river blockades any towers being placed on that part of the map. Lollipops and chocolate bars are found around the map. The brown path began and ends at two candy caves. The path is dead straight, with no turns and is very short. The map slowly corrupts, turning parts of the map into a dark black color, and making other objects float in the sky. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Classic Candy Cane Lane}} ==Event Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|100}} ÷ (1 + [(12 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.3 |({{Exp|30}} ÷ (1 + [(12 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.3 |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which could be obtained when playing this map, which may have had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Premium 1 |image = PremiumBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Token|1}} }} {{Badge |title = Tix 1 |image = TixBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Tix|1}} }} ==Wave Structure== Wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|100}} + (Waves Completed × {{Money|850}})^0.99 Wave clear bonus is 35% of the wave bonus. ==Strategy== *This map uses preset loadouts, with the towers being the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Soldier]], [[Demoman]], and [[Paintballer]]. **Additionally, these skins use their default appearances and cannot have their gold perk enabled. *The [[Soldier]] can be very effective at killing enemies, due to its high DPS. **It can also be useful against the multiple [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute enemies that appear. *The [[Demoman]] and [[Paintballer]] can be useful at clearing out the hordes of enemies that appear on this map. ==Trivia== *This map is based on [[Candy Cane Lane]], an old now removed map. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Classic Candy Cane Lane''' added. **{{Bug}} Towers can have other skins if the tower is equipped in the lobby. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Classic Candy Cane Lane''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Classic Candy Cane Lane''' re-added, to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode only. **{{Bug}} Wave structure no longer plays. **{{Bug}} {{Tix|}} no longer spins. **{{Bug}} Map no longer corrupts. {{TheClassicMaps|Start|N/A|[[Classic Candy Cane Lane]]|Mission 1|[[Classic Winter]]|Mission 2}} {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Sandbox Only Maps]]
